 Search... News Grand Theft Auto 6 Star Manni L. Perez Is a Real-Life Weightlifter and MMA Fighter
 by Rick Saleeby Published on Nov 19, 2026 
 Image embed via Instagram  @gta6.only 
 The actress behind GTA 6’s Lucia Caminos has trained in weightlifting, Muay Thai, Brazilian jiu-jitsu and mixed martial arts
 The day is finally here! Millions of gamers are expected to skip school or call out today as Grand Theft Auto 6 goes live around the world. And one of the game’s biggest stars has a surprising connection to the fitness world. The actress portraying Lucia Caminos in Rockstar Games’ blockbuster, Manni L. Perez, is a real-life weightlifter and fighter, who has spent years developing her strength and fighting skills. 
 Perez’s identity as Lucia became public on November 17 after she received a Best Performance nomination at The Game Awards. The announcement confirmed years of speculation surrounding the actress behind one of the game’s two main characters.
 For bodybuilding and MMA fans, Perez’s athletic background makes her an especially interesting choice for the role.
 View this post on Instagram 
 Manni L. Perez Has a Background in Weightlifting and MMA 
 Long before becoming one of the faces of Grand Theft Auto 6, Perez was training in the gym and practicing multiple combat sports.
 Her athletic background includes:
 Weightlifting and strength training
 Mixed martial arts (MMA)
 Muay Thai
 Brazilian jiu-jitsu 
 Stunt work and fight choreography
 Professional belly dancing
 In a 2018 interview with PAZ Magazine, Perez explained how her physical abilities helped distinguish her from other performers competing for action-oriented roles.
 “I have a very specific niche in the industry,” Perez said. “A lot of the roles I get called in for require me to be fit, strong, and kick ass.”
 Perez has also discussed how her ability to perform stunts and fight sequences provides an advantage during auditions.
 Her professional acting profile lists personal training among her skills, while a 2020 biography highlighted weight training as one of her favorite activities outside acting.
 View this post on Instagram 
 From Playing a Boxer to Becoming GTA 6’s Lucia 
 Perez’s fighting background has already played a significant role in her acting career.
 In 2020, she portrayed boxer Esperanza Morales in an episode of Law & Order: Special Victims Unit titled “Redemption in Her Corner.”
 The performance earned Perez an Imagen Award for Best Supporting Actress in Television.
 Her other acting credits include Chicago P.D. , Jessica Jones , The Blacklist , and Spike Lee’s She’s Gotta Have It .
 Interestingly, GTA 6 is not her first appearance in the franchise. Perez previously provided minor character voices for Grand Theft Auto V and GTA Online.
 View this post on Instagram 
 GTA 6 Introduces a Fighter With Real-Life Experience 
 Perez’s athletic abilities make an interesting connection to Lucia’s fictional background.
 According to Rockstar Games, Lucia learned to fight from her father while growing up in Liberty City. Her story eventually takes her to the fictional state of Leonida, where she becomes involved in criminal activities alongside Jason Duval.
 Although it is unclear whether Perez’s martial arts experience directly influenced the character’s development, her background in combat sports closely resembles Lucia’s fighting abilities.
 Grand Theft Auto 6 launches today, November 19, 2026, for PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X/S.
